description.narrative: The Instituto Peruano del Deporte (IPD) has requested the assistance of UNOPS to adminstrate the funds provided by the Government of Peru to improve the facilties for the public in coliseums and sport centers for the different activities held by the IPD's regional divisions, and to optimize the resources and enhance the quality of the services given to the population in sports centres. UNOPS will carry out the restoring of the synthetic soccer surface field of the Estadio Atletico de La Videna in Lima and Estadio Miguel Grau in Piura. UNOPS will contact firms for the execution of the Coliseo de Sullana in Piura, for the grandstands of the Estadio de Moyobamba, and others. Gymnastic equipment and CCTV supplies are also being procured as part of the project as well as additional services such as civil works and local consultants.
